title: Get spend limits
description: Per product, the spend limit for the current period, a limit deferred to the next period because it was set below current spend, spend so far, and whether the limit is reached. Needs full billing access. Use it for "am I over my spend limit"; the quota limiting state PostHog applies is on billing-usage-summary-get. Beta: behind the organization-billing-api flag, and the output shape may change while it is.

methodDocumentation.text: In beta: the organization billing API is behind the organization-billing-api feature flag and answers 403 without it, so ask support for access. Its shapes may change while it is in beta.
